ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white background (approx. 80%) with high-contrast low-intensity dark-grey and black pixel clusters (approx. 20%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density dark pigmentation concentrated along the trailing edges and median notch. Contiguous low-intensity regions present at the extreme lateral tips. Numerous discrete dark circular blobs distributed across the medial and distal regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an estimated internal pixel angle of 42 degrees; depth extends significantly into the fluke body relative to the horizontal span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge exhibits low-amplitude serrations across the majority of the boundary, transitioning to high-amplitude, irregular protrusions and notches at the left and right distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges follow a continuous convex curve from the peduncle attachment point to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread distribution of circular and sub-circular high-contrast dark pixel clusters across both lobes, particularly dense in the inner-medial regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct horizontal low-intensity linear disruption is visible on the right lobe, originating near the median notch and extending laterally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent horizontal linear scar on the interior right lobe; irregular, jagged trailing edge morphology on both the far left and right lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-frequency speckled pigmentation pattern covering the entire visible ventral surface.
